names.note: The calendar’s own name page for her is «Татиана (Бякирева), исп.»; the rank is stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «… и Татианы испп». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1948)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Свв. Анны и Татианы испп (1948).»

attestations.note: The second of the two one line names, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGES ARE ALL THERE IS. «Испп» is the plural of исп., исповедница, a woman confessor, and the name page repeats it and adds no monastic grade, so she is recorded with `confessor` alone and no office. No folder held her: a Cyrillic grep for «Бякирева» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints eleven hymns and none is under either name.
